Spanish Potato Tortilla

Thick, runny in the middle, golden outside

Prep: 15 minCook: 30 minTotal: 0.8h4 servings

Ingredients

  • 5 huevos grandes
  • 700 g patatas para freír
  • 1 cebolla mediana
  • 250 ml aceite de oliva (suave o virgen)
  • al gusto sal gorda

Method

  1. Cut. Slice the potatoes thin (or small dice, as your household prefers) and julienne the onion.
  2. Confit. Put the potatoes and onion in a pan with the cold oil and salt. Cook over medium-low heat 20–25 minutes, without browning: they should soften like a confit.
  3. Mix. Drain the potatoes and onion (save the oil for another day) and fold them into the beaten, salted eggs in a large bowl. Rest 10 minutes — the potato drinks the egg.
  4. Set. Pour into a nonstick pan with two spoonfuls of the oil. Over medium-high heat, set the edges 2–3 minutes, pressing a flat plate on top to compact it.
  5. The flip. Using the plate, turn it over with conviction and slide the tortilla back into the pan. Cook 2 more minutes: the center should stay runny.
Grandma's note. Better eggs, better tortilla. And resting the mixture before cooking is the trick almost nobody mentions.
